proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.kind = "destroy_target"
proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke's failed-save branch deterministically removes the creature from play rather than damaging, exiling, or transforming it. No existing effect atom captures outright destruction with no remains.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains.

proposed_widenings.name: event-driven magic-item contact/possession damage
proposed_widenings.justification: The talisman deals damage when a qualifying creature touches it and again at the end of each of that creature's turns while it keeps holding or carrying it. The current passive surface only supports always-on grants and elapsed-time passive operations, not item-contact triggers plus repeated holder-turn damage.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Radiant damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.any_of(wearing_item, holding_item)
proposed_widenings.justification: Both the passive spell-attack bonus and the activated rebuke are gated by wearing OR holding the item. The current equipment predicates can express conjunction via all_of, but not this disjunction.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it. While wearing or holding the talisman, you can take a Magic action...

proposed_widenings.name: save_gate conditional disadvantage for qualifying target types
proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke alters the saving-throw mode only for Fiends and Undead. Existing save_gate payloads do not have a target-type-conditional disadvantage hook.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the target is a Fiend or an Undead, it has Disadvantage on the save.

proposed_widenings.name: target selection predicate = on_ground
proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke can only target a creature on the ground. Current target selection supports counts and creature-type filters, but not positional predicates like grounded-only targeting.
proposed_widenings.evidence: target one creature you can see on the ground within 120 feet of yourself

notes: Did not author content/traces. The item fits the existing magic_item top-level kind, but its core mechanics require both new surface variants and a new effect atom, so any current JSON would be materially misleading.
